run_evaluator_all_evals: run all evaluations for ODE convergence speed, control, and fourier condition init tasks
check_hypothesis_ode_convergence: check a hypothesis for ODE convergence speed by comparing predicted and target float values
check_hypothesis_ode_control: check a hypothesis for ODE control by comparing gramians or degree predictions
check_fourier_cond_init: check fourier condition init hypothesis by comparing regularity and stability values between target and hypothesis
compare_gramians: compare two gramian matrices element-wise with a tolerance threshold and optional norm1 aggregation
